messages:
PagerDuty: :rotating_light: P0 — High GPU queue growth / failed scale-up in gcp-southamerica-east1. Multiple timeouts observed, error=quotaExceeded. Paging oncall. thread: https://pd.example/INC12345
Anya (oncall): ack, investigating now. I’m looking at autoscaler logs and recent deploys.
InfraBot: Autoscaler attempt at 1746504300 failed: 
```
ERROR: API call to compute.googleapis.com returned quotaExceeded (403) - 'Requested resource has insufficient quota.'
Details: Quota Metric: GPUs, Region: southamerica-east1, Project: redwood-prod
```
Kevin (sre): seeing steady queue growth on inference-frontend (tokens/sec backlog). Current queue length ~12k requests, error rate 5-7% 503s.
David (infra): confirmed GCE returned: 
```
"Quota 'GPUS' exceeded for project 1234567890 in region southamerica-east1"
```
David (infra): warm pool attempts also hit quota — nodes not provisioning. Looks like we've exhausted region GPU quota for the project.
Marisol (CS): customers reporting slow inference and 502/503 spikes. Any broad customer impact list? I’ve started notifying top-10 customers on the watchlist.
Anya (oncall): quick triage: impact = degraded hosted API latency for region-local traffic + failed Dedicated scaleups for some customers pinned to that region. Longer tail for queued jobs.
OpsLead: immediate mitigation plan: 1) Reroute new requests for susceptible routes to eu-west1 fallback pool, 2) Enable aggressive prefix/KV cache for embeddings routes, 3) Apply capacity-shed policy for non-critical background workloads. Execute now.
Kevin (sre): I can flip routing rules. Suggest we add a 403->fallback rule in routing layer so autoscaler failures trigger cross-region failover. Minimal config change.
Anya (oncall): Kevin — go ahead. Post command when you run it.
Kevin (sre): running routing change (will take ~30s):
```
# route-servicectl set-fallback --route inference.text.generate --from-region southamerica-east1 --to-region eu-west1 --reason "gpu_quota_exhausted"
```
Kevin (sre): done. Started gradual 10%->50%->100% traffic shift for inference.text.generate. Monitoring latency and error rate.
David (infra): also creating a temporary non-GPU fallback for smaller models to reduce GPU pressure. Will update canary list.
InfraBot: Deploy bot: canary routing update deployed to infra-router v2.14. Rollout status: 100% to eu-west1 fallback.
Anya (oncall): good. Initiating customer communications template for impacted tenants. Marisol, can you send the updated note? Keep it cautious re: ETA.
Marisol (CS): on it — sending heads-up now to enterprise contacts, marking as "degraded performance; automated failover in progress".
Kevin (sre): note — dedicated customers with pinned region-only pools will still be impacted until quotas are increased or we migrate them. We should list those customers for CS.
Anya (oncall): Kevin/David — compile affected tenant list and queue sizes by tenant. I’ll escalate to cloud contact for quota increase.
David (infra): collecting tenant metrics now. Rough numbers: 4 dedicated tenants pinned (A,B,C,D) with 40% of backlog; hosted customers account for remaining 60%.
Kevin (sre): short-term extra mitigation: enable preemption-aware shedding for best-effort background jobs in southamerica cluster. Command:
```
kubectl patch hpa inference-bg -p '{"spec":{"minReplicas":0}}'
```
Anya (oncall): running quota request to GCP now (internal link). Note: GCP quota requests often take hours -> not reliable for immediate relief.
Anya (oncall): handoff plan: After we stabilize routing, I’m escalating to OpsLead for decision on customer migrations. I will hand off to Sofia (next oncall) at shift change 1746505200.
Sofia (oncall-next): ack — I’ll pick this up at handoff and keep the routing rules monitored. If backlog not decreasing in 30m, plan to spin up eu-west1 warm pool and begin manual tenant migration (non-disruptive where possible).
OpsLead: decision — no forced tenant migrations without consent. For dedicated customers, Ops will contact and offer assisted migration or temporary credits.
Marisol (CS): sending personalized DMs to pinned customers now offering migration assistance.
Kevin (sre): observed queue decreasing after routing change: queue down from 12k -> 3.7k in 9m. Error rate dropped from ~6% -> 1.2%. Still monitoring memory pressure on eu-west1 fallback.
David (infra): tracking billing/cost impact for cross-region failover — Ops, flag for possible chargeback.
Anya (oncall): summary for handoff -> Incident: gpu quota exhausted in gcp-southamerica-east1 causing autoscaler failures and request queue growth. Mitigations executed: routing fallback to eu-west1, cache/prefix settings increased, background shedding, customer comms. Next steps: follow quota request with GCP support, review long-term quota strategy (warmpools, regional soft caps), follow-up Postmortem.
PagerDuty: Incident INC12345 still active — severity P0. Next update required in 30m.
Sofia (oncall-next): picking up. If anything changes ping me @sofia. I'll create a follow-up thread for postmortem action items after resolution.
Anya (oncall): handing off now. Good job team. :thumbsup:
